name: [USE NOW - READ ONLY] AGE 07 - Chatwoot PostgreSQL Campaign Delivery/Read Analytics

parameters.query:
-- AGE 07 | SELECT only | v4.19.0 source contract | Account 2 only
-- Dedicated private Chatwoot PostgreSQL credential: SELECT on
-- campaigns, campaign_recipients and inboxes. NO application DB owner token.
-- Unlicensed enterprise features must not be activated by this workflow.
WITH campaign_rollup AS (
  SELECT c.account_id, c.id AS internal_campaign_id,
         c.display_id AS campaign_display_id, c.title AS campaign_name,
         c.inbox_id,
         COUNT(cr.id)::bigint AS audience,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 0)::bigint AS queued,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 1)::bigint AS skipped,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 2)::bigint AS sent_only,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 3)::bigint AS delivered_only,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 4)::bigint AS read_confirmed,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 5)::bigint AS failed,
         COUNT(cr.source_id)::bigint AS provider_id_present,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.source_id LIKE 'wamid.%')::bigint AS wamid_format,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.delivered_at IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS delivered_timestamps,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.read_at IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS read_timestamps,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.failed_at IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS failure_timestamps,
         COUNT(cr.id) FILTER (WHERE cr.status = 5 AND NULLIF(cr.error_code, '') IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS coded_failures,
         MAX(cr.updated_at) AS last_recipient_update
  FROM campaigns c
  INNER JOIN inboxes i ON i.id = c.inbox_id
    AND i.account_id = c.account_id AND i.channel_type = 'Channel::Whatsapp'
  LEFT JOIN campaign_recipients cr ON cr.campaign_id = c.id
    AND cr.account_id = c.account_id
  WHERE c.account_id = 2 AND c.campaign_type = 1
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.id, c.display_id, c.title, c.inbox_id
),
error_counts AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, jsonb_object_agg(error_code, count_rows) AS error_code_counts
  FROM (
    SELECT cr.campaign_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(cr.error_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS error_code,
           COUNT(*)::bigint AS count_rows
    FROM campaign_recipients cr
    WHERE cr.account_id = 2 AND cr.status = 5
    GROUP BY cr.campaign_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(cr.error_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN')
  ) e
  GROUP BY campaign_id
)
SELECT r.*, (r.delivered_only + r.read_confirmed) AS delivered_including_read,
       COALESCE(e.error_code_counts, '{}'::jsonb) AS error_code_counts
FROM campaign_rollup r
LEFT JOIN error_counts e ON e.campaign_id = r.internal_campaign_id
ORDER BY r.last_recipient_update DESC NULLS LAST, r.internal_campaign_id DESC
LIMIT 201;
